title: Airspeed Indicator
description: An aircraft airspeed indicator: an arc sweeps over the speed bands with the live reading and turns red past the red line.

title: Attitude Indicator
description: An attitude indicator: the horizon pitches and banks behind a fixed aircraft symbol while a tilt table moves the unit.

title: Altimeter
description: An altimeter: an arc sweeps up to the live altitude while a cyan bug marks the selected one, and the reading stays in the center.

title: Turn Coordinator
description: A turn coordinator: the aircraft banks onto the standard-rate mark with the turn rate, and the ball slips in its tube.

title: Heading Indicator
description: A heading indicator: the compass card turns under the lubber line to the live heading, with a cyan bug on the selected one.

title: Vertical Speed Indicator
description: A vertical speed indicator: an arc fills up from zero in a climb and down in a descent, and turns red past the sink rate limit.

title: TVAC Chamber Pressure
description: Thermal vacuum chamber pressure on a log scale from atmosphere to high vacuum, with the 1.33 × 10⁻³ Pa test vacuum line.

title: TVAC Thermal Cycle
description: A thermal vacuum cycle: the baseplate temperature against the cold and hot plateau setpoints, with the ±2 °C tolerance band and the dwell time.

title: Random Vibration
description: A random vibration run stepping −12, −6, −3 dB to full level, with the control Grms against the reference and its ±10 % tolerance band.

title: Spacecraft Power Bus
description: The 28 V bus feeding a unit under test, against its 22 to 36 V input range, with the current drawn and the inrush at switch-on.

title: RF Link Acquisition
description: Downlink acquisition on the RF checkout equipment: carrier, bit sync and frame sync locks in order, and Eb/N0 against the 9.6 dB BPSK threshold.

title: State of Charge
description: The pack's state of charge as a battery outline that fills with the live SOC, with the cycler step next to it.

title: Pack Current
description: Pack current on a center-zero tape: charge fills right, discharge fills left, red past the charge and discharge limits.

title: Max Temperature
description: Eight thermistors as dots on one temperature scale, with the hottest one named and limits that follow charge or discharge.

title: Cell Voltage Balance
description: Each of 13 cells as its deviation from the pack mean in mV, with balancing lights and the spread against its limits.

title: Pack Voltage
description: Pack voltage on a tape against the CV setpoint, red past the undervoltage and overvoltage limits.
